review.notes: Vendored cyberkaida/reverse-engineering-assistant (ReVa) ReVa/skills/ at deb6c4e - resolved live against GitHub, non-fork, 824 stars/72 forks, Apache-2.0, single owner matching the plan author handle. Read all 6 SKILL.md and both companion files in full. reva-binary-triage and reva-deep-analysis retargeted from ReVas own kebab-case tool surface onto pyghidra-mcps 20 tools (adaptation.toolRenames left empty: this is a lossy many-to-many retarget, not a clean 1:1 rename map - every live tool-call instruction in the adapted body was hand-verified against data/tool-catalog.json, and every remaining mention of a ReVa tool name is explicit gap documentation, never a callable instruction; see task-18-reva-report.md). Carried forward the ai_-prefix/SourceType and gen_callgraph+list_exports invariant-bracket conventions from the ghidra pack onto this same server. Documented that ReVas Action Log human-approval queue for database writes does not exist on pyghidra-mcp; mutations commit immediately. reva-ctf-rev/reva-ctf-crypto/reva-ctf-pwn/reva-pyghidra-scripting vendored but disabled - out of scope for this tasks triage/deep-analysis mandate, bodies not retargeted, directories renamed only. Deleted deep-analysis/examples.md during adaptation (unreferenced by SKILL.md, entirely ReVa-tool-syntax, redundant with the SKILL.md own adapted example; pristine copy recoverable from the pack commit). Scanner re-run over the full adapted tree: clean, no scanExceptions.
